description: Change a widget's title, query, visualization type, configuration, data source or position. Only the fields you pass are changed.

allowSharedAcrossAllCustomers.description: Only for customer dashboards. Set true, after the user explicitly confirms, to allow a query with no per-customer filter.

layout.description: Position and size on the 12-column grid. Omit on create and a free slot is chosen for you.

viewId.description: View id the widget belongs to.

visualizationConfig.description: Replaces the whole configuration object, so include every key you want to keep.

name: update_widget
title: Update a widget
